title: Upgrade Slots
description:
Backpacks have **upgrade slots** along the side. This is where the mod stops being a bigger inventory and starts being a tool.

Every upgrade is built on an **Upgrade Base**, so make a few.

Higher backpack tiers have more slots. Copper is the first step up, and copper is easy to come by here.

*Press U on an Upgrade Base to see everything it becomes.*
